name: Two-Obstruction PC-Minor Basis for Paths
statement: A finite partial cube is a path if and only if it has no pc-minor isomorphic to $C_4$ or $K_{1,3}$; both obstructions are pc-minimal.
proof: Avoiding $C_4$ forces the graph to be a tree. A nonpath tree has a vertex with three incident edges, whose center and three neighbors form a convex $K_{1,3}$. Proper pc-minors of both listed graphs are paths.
